notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Colossal Clone Master from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Colossal Clone Master.
Colossal Clone Master triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Colossal Clone Master, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat each turn.
